high_level_description: The image shows a person wearing a red bandana with white circular patterns on their head. The person is wearing a dark green ribbed shirt and has a backpack strap visible over one shoulder. The background appears to be an outdoor setting, possibly a street or alleyway, with a corrugated metal wall on the right side.
